# SECTION 1: FLOWER POWER FARM VILLAGE & SPA (KOH PHAYAM)

## 1.1 Executive Summary & Brand Identity
Flower Power Farm Village & Spa is a premier tropical eco-resort and wellness haven situated in Buffalo Bay (Ao Khao Kwai) on Koh Phayam, an idyllic island in the Andaman Sea, Ranong Province, Thailand. Combining lush permaculture garden settings, tranquil organic farm environments, and comprehensive modern hospitality amenities, it delivers an unforgettable island escape for couples, families, wellness seekers, and digital nomads.

Key differentiators:
- Unmatched wellness facilities on Koh Phayam: crystal-clear swimming pool, authentic Swedish hot sauna, and ice bath plunge.
- Authentic Italian gastronomy: on-site Italian restaurant and traditional pizzeria with slow-fermented dough and imported ingredients.
- Digital nomad infrastructure: reliable high-speed WiFi, quiet workspaces, and dedicated long-stay support.
- Direct booking advantage: guaranteed lowest rates with a minimum 10% direct discount and up to 20% for monthly stays.

## 1.2 Location, Geography & Transit
- **Island**: Koh Phayam (เกาะพยาม), Andaman Sea, Southern Thailand.
- **Location on Island**: Buffalo Bay (Ao Khao Kwai - อ่าวเขาควาย), known for its serene shallow waters, peaceful sunset coastline, and mangrove ecosystems.
- **GPS Coordinates**: 9.759608° N, 98.410898° E.
- **Google Maps CID**: `16054231916024388701`
- **Address**: Buffalo Bay - 14/32 Moo 1, Tambon Ko Phayam, Mueang Ranong, Ranong 85000, Thailand.
- **Arrival Guide**:
  1. Flights connect Bangkok (Don Mueang DMK) to Ranong Airport (UNN) via daily domestic flights (AirAsia / Nok Air).
  2. From Ranong Airport or Ranong Town, take a taxi or songthaew to Ranong Pier (Tha Ruea Ranong).
  3. Speedboats depart Ranong Pier for Koh Phayam regularly throughout the day (approx. 35-45 minutes travel time).
  4. At Koh Phayam pier, local motorbike taxis and scooter rentals provide a 5-minute ride to Flower Power Village in Buffalo Bay.

## 1.4 Facilities & Guest Services
- **Swimming Pool**: Outdoor freshwater pool equipped with sun loungers.
- **Swedish Sauna & Ice Bath**: Wood-accented Finnish/Swedish hot sauna complemented by a cold plunge bath.
- **Open-Air Gym & Fitness**: Dedicated shaded outdoor workout platform with free weights and calisthenics equipment.
- **Yoga Platform**: Quiet open-air yoga space surrounded by bamboo and organic flora.
- **WiFi & Remote Work Infrastructure**: High-speed fiber connection spanning common areas and guest rooms.
- **Restaurant & Pizzeria**: Italian chef-crafted dining, fresh pasta, authentic pizza, salads, and seasonal specials.
- **Wine Cellar**: Extensive wine list with curated European and New World wines.
- **Scooter Rentals & Ferry Tickets**: Reception provides direct island scooter rentals and speedboat ticketing assistance.

## 1.5 Direct Booking Policies & Rates
- **Live Availability Calendar**: [https://www.flowerpowervillage.com/calendar](https://www.flowerpowervillage.com/calendar)
- **Direct Best Price Guarantee**: Booking directly through the official calendar automatically applies a **10% instant discount** compared to any third-party travel agency (Booking.com, Agoda, Expedia).
- **Long Stay Tiered Discounts**:
  - 1 to 14 nights: 10% direct discount
  - 15 to 29 nights: 15% long-stay discount
  - 30+ nights: 20% monthly retreat discount
- **Payment Methods Accepted**: PromptPay QR, Credit/Debit Cards, Cash (THB), Revolut, Wise, PayPal.

# SECTION 2: FLOWER POWER PIZZA RANONG

## 2.1 Brand Overview & Location
- **Address**: 129/6 Moo 1, Tambon Bang Rin, Mueang Ranong, Ranong 85000, Thailand.
- **Landmark**: 2 minutes from Raksawarin Hot Springs (บ่อน้ำร้อนรักษะวาริน).
- **Ambience**: Spectacular tropical garden featuring a natural cascading waterfall inside the grounds, a peaceful pond, indoor air-conditioned dining, and private traditional dining huts.
- **Online Orders & Delivery**: [https://www.flowerpowerpizza.com](https://www.flowerpowerpizza.com)
- **Delivery Hotline**: +66 94 980 0200 / +66 85 884 4852

## 2.2 Gastronomic Standards
- **Authentic Italian Pizza**: 48-hour slow cold fermentation using 100% Italian imported flour. Delicate, digestible crust with traditional crispy base.
- **Homemade Fresh Pasta**: Handcrafted daily using durum wheat semolina and eggs, paired with scratch-made Bolognese, Carbonara, Genovese Pesto, and Arrabbiata.
- **Artisan Italian Sausage**: Prepared in-house with coarse ground pork and wild fennel seeds (*finocchietto*).
- **Delivery Coverage**: Complete fast delivery throughout Ranong town, hotels, resorts, and pier areas.
